title: Kinematic Constraint-Referenced Evaluation for Articulated Object Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Manipulation policies are evaluated predominantly by binary task success, which cannot tell whether the commanded gesture is the one the object's kinematics admit. We introduce Constraint-Referenced Strategy (CRS), which projects the commanded end-effector twist onto the object's joint axis, separating progress along the joint from off-constraint waste. CRS requires a joint model and a joint-following scripted controller derived from it, but no recorded demonstration or learned judge. On 74 simulated articulated objects, success registers three transfer failures as lower rates but attributes none, while the two CRS channels give each a distinct signature. A door-trained behavior-cloning policy opens drawers in 59 of 110 episodes, and in these passes it commands about $40\times$ the off-axis rotation of a drawer-trained policy's passes ($1.27$ vs.\ $0.032$~rad/s). translated_title: 面向铰接物体操作的运动学约束参考评估
translated_abstract: 操作策略目前主要以二元任务成功与否来评估，这种方式无法判断所下达的动作是否是物体运动学所允许的动作。我们提出了约束参考策略（CRS），它将末端执行器的指令速度旋量投影到物体的关节轴上，从而将沿关节的有效进展与偏离约束的无效动作区分开来。CRS只需要一个关节模型以及由其推导出的跟随关节的脚本控制器，而不需要记录的演示数据或学习到的评判器。在74个仿真铰接物体上，传统成功率评估只能将三种迁移失败记录为较低的比率，却无法归因原因，而CRS的两个通道则为每种失败提供了独特的特征签名。一个用门训练的行为克隆策略在110次回合中成功打开了59次抽屉，而在这些成功的回合中，它所指令的离轴旋转量约为用抽屉训练的策略的40倍（1.27 对比 0.032 rad/s）。相对于用同一关节轴评分的脚本控制器，CRS的判定……
tldr: 提出约束参考策略（CRS），通过将末端执行器指令速度投影到物体关节轴上，将沿关节的有效进展与偏离约束的无效动作区分开，从而诊断出传统二元成功率无法归因的迁移失败。
en_tdlr: Proposes Constraint-Referenced Strategy (CRS), which projects commanded end-effector twists onto the object's joint axis to separate joint progress from off-constraint waste, enabling diagnosis of transfer failures that binary task success rates cannot attribute.
